def factor_drawdown_stress_smoothed(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    peak_high = df_copy['high'].rolling(40, min_periods=40).max()
    drawdown = (df_copy['close'] - peak_high) / peak_high.replace(0, np.nan)
    max_drawdown = drawdown.rolling(40, min_periods=40).min()
    atr = talib.ATR(df_copy['high'], df_copy['low'], df_copy['close'], timeperiod=20)
    factor = -max_drawdown / atr.replace(0, np.nan)
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    factor = factor.rolling(3, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy['factor_drawdown_stress_smoothed'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_drawdown_stress_smoothed']
